angle: Preply's homepage evolution is the story of a consumer tutoring marketplace that quietly added a corporate sales motion — 'Book a demo' — without removing its individual-learner paths, suggesting the company decided to serve two buyer types from one page rather than pick one. The headline shift from 'speak confidently' to 'learn faster' is the visible version of a less visible strategic bet.
